response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong DLang, TypeScript, and web/infrastructure experience, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming experience (only brief early-career exposure to C/C++ at National Instruments and a bachelor thesis project) and shows no evidence of large-scale cloud compute platform leadership, distributed systems architecture at scale, or formal technical leadership mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers.
strengths: Broad, deep technical versatility across many languages, platforms, and paradigms (web, mobile, embedded, systems)
Demonstrated thought leadership via talks, workshops, and open-source project creation
Long tenure of senior/staff-level titles indicating strong individual technical capability
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (well short of the required 8 years) — mostly early-career and hobbyist
No evidence of large-scale distributed systems, cloud compute platform, or hardware/storage architecture work at the scale implied by the role
No clear track record of formal technical leadership or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers, nor managing cross-team priorities and deadlines

key_factors.factor: C++ experience far below required 8 years
No large-scale cloud/distributed compute platform leadership experience
Strong general software craftsmanship and mentoring/teaching inclination
